title: Continuity of the tropical Prym-Torelli map
summary: We give a new intrinsic construction of the continuous tropical Prym variety, originally due to Röhrle and Zakahrov. In particular, given a harmonic double cover of graphs we explicitly construct the tropical Prym as integral torus. Moreover, we show that the tropical Prym--Torelli map from the moduli space of harmonic double covers to the moduli space of principally polarised tropical abelian varieties is continuous.
